description: Google Maps API: Search places. Places matching a query, optionally around a point, up to 20 per call. Price: 3 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

q.description: What to search, e.g. `dentist in Berlin`

region.description: Two-letter country code to bias results

name: maps_places_search
title: Search places
